      "rationale": "In 8 FAM 403.1-4(d)(1), C0005 imposes a mandatory duty to suspend an application to request acceptable ID in the new name. The second sentence provides an exception allowing a limited-validity passport to be issued when urgent or emergency travel precludes requesting ID. Following instructions to preserve the ordinary permission in baseline C0006 while adding a companion qualification with modality not_stated and relation exception, this record qualifies and relaxes C0005.",
      "operation": "add",
      "target": "",
      "qualifies": ["C0005"],
      "quote": "If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;",
      "fields": {
        "kind": "exception",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change"
        ],
        "scope_text": "If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, and there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.",

        "summary": "As an exception to suspending the DS-11 application to request updated ID (C0005), a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name if there is insufficient time before urgent or emergency travel."

      "rationale": "Paragraph d introduces the governing condition under 22 CFR 51.23(c) for when evidence of identity may be required pursuant to Department guidance, directly introducing the conditional list in (1)–(3).
